error_logs: ERROR 2026-07-22 15:23:00 notification-service.mailer: OSError: [Errno 110] Connection timed out while connecting to email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:587

ERROR 2026-07-22 15:55:00 notification-service.worker: MaxRetryError: SQS message failed 5 times, sending to dead_letter_queue
incident.root_cause: Terraform security group update on 2026-07-22 tightened default egress to port 443 only, inadvertently dropping outbound TCP traffic on port 587 needed by notification-service.

incident.runbook: RB-INFRA-07: VPC Security Group & Egress Connectivity Troubleshooting

incident.title: search-indexer and reporting-service Crash Loop on Dropped Ledger Column (2026-08-06)
incident.impact: Merchant transaction search offline for 80 minutes; overnight reporting pipeline halted; 12,000 ledger events queued in Kafka DLQ.
error_logs: CRITICAL 2026-08-06 16:06:00 search-indexer.consumer: KeyError: 'legacy_settlement_id' missing from CDC event payload
ERROR 2026-08-06 16:34:00 reporting-service.pipeline: psycopg2.errors.UndefinedColumn: column ledger_entries.legacy_settlement_id does not exist
FATAL 2026-08-06 16:43:00 search-indexer: ConsumerGroupOffsetExpiredException: max retry limit exceeded on topic ledger.events
incident.root_cause: Destructive schema migration in ledger-service on 2026-08-06 dropped legacy_settlement_id immediately without a multi-phase deprecation or backfill phase, crashing downstream consumers.
incident.fix_steps: Executed hotfix migration adding back legacy_settlement_id as a generated column aliased to settlement_epoch, resumed Kafka consumer offsets.
incident.runbook: RB-DB-02: Zero-Downtime Schema Evolution & Consumer Recovery

incident.title: search-indexer Shard Allocation Rejection on High Disk Watermark (2026-08-10)
incident.impact: search-indexer operational degradation for 70 minutes; background incident unrelated to CI/CD pipeline pattern.
error_logs: WARN  2026-08-10 14:49:00 search-indexer.monitor: Resource threshold exceeded warning on cluster worker node
ERROR 2026-08-10 15:08:00 search-indexer.core: Unexpected runtime failure: search-indexer Shard Allocation Rejection on High Disk Watermark
FATAL 2026-08-10 15:18:00 search-indexer.supervisor: Worker heartbeats missed, triggering automated alert
incident.root_cause: ElasticSearch data node crossed 85% low-watermark threshold, preventing primary shard reallocation after a node replacement. Occurred on 2026-08-10.
incident.fix_steps: Expanded EBS volume from 250GB to 500GB and triggered cluster reroute with retry_failed=true.

incident.title: checkout-web HTTP 401 Unauthorized Spike Following Auth JWT Upgrade (2026-08-11)
incident.impact: Valid logged-in users rejected at checkout page with 'Session Expired' for 63 minutes; 3102 checkout abandonments.
error_logs: WARN  2026-08-11 16:50:00 checkout-web.auth: jwt.exceptions.InvalidAlgorithmError: The specified alg 'RS256' requires strict key format validation in pyjwt>=2.10
ERROR 2026-08-11 17:12:00 checkout-web.session: Failed to decode user session token from Authorization header: verification failed
INFO  2026-08-11 17:33:00 auth-service: Rejected token issue: clock skew tolerance exceeded (0s threshold)
incident.root_cause: auth-service pyjwt dependency upgrade on 2026-08-11 enforced strict asymmetric key formatting and zero leeway on clock skew, rejecting valid JWT tokens issued by older client instances.
incident.fix_steps: Configured jwt.decode leeway=10s and aligned public key PEM header formatting; rolled back auth-service to pyjwt 2.8.0 pending client rollout.
incident.runbook: RB-SEC-09: JWT Token Invalidation & Algorithm Rotation
